create_table: CREATE TABLE correos (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, tabla TEXT NOT NULL, idregistro INTEGER NOT NULL, correo TEXT NOT NULL)

pull.sql: SELECT idcorreo AS id, 'clientes' AS tabla, idfila AS idregistro, correo FROM correos WHERE idtabla IN (2) AND idcorreo > %s AND idcorreo <= @@last_id ORDER BY idcorreo
pull.lookup: JOIN sync_ids b ON b.id_servidor = ? AND b.tabla = 'correos'

queue.sql: SELECT idcorreo AS id, 'clientes' AS tabla, idfila AS idregistro, correo FROM correos WHERE idtabla IN (2)

push.join: JOIN correos b ON b.id = a.idregistro LEFT JOIN sync_ids c ON c.id_local = b.idregistro AND c.tabla = 'clientes'
